[[File:SwarmMines-SW.png|thumb|right|250px|Swarm mines attach to a powerful magnet]]
'''Swarm mines''' were levitating [[Mine/Legends|mines]] that usually clustered together for maximum explosion power. They were deployed on [[Aut-O/Legends|Aut-O's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] in the vault that carried a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Encryption module/Legends|encryption module]].

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
According to the Clone Wars Facebook page, the swarm mines were based directly on the vocal emulator device Obi-Wan used while disguised as Rako Hardeen in the episode ''[[Deception]]''.<ref name="fb">{{Facebook|username=StarWarsTheCloneWars|url=photo.php?fbid=473947269311239&set=a.350962014943099.76071.328988200473814&type=1|name=Star Wars: The Clone Wars|date=2 December 2012|archivedate=20200820164531}}</ref>
